note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF campground under tall Jeffrey pines beside Robinson Creek on Twin Lakes Road, 10 miles from Bridgeport at 7,000 ft, near Upper and Lower Twin Lakes. Each site has a bear locker, and a furnished yurt is also rented. A free California campfire permit is needed for fires, grills and stoves. --Claude
summary: Paha (Humboldt-Toiyabe NF): creekside KEPT - lidar puts Robinson Creek 5-30 m from sites 009, 012, 013, 018 with a 1-2 m drop; 21 sites (20 + yurt, was 26), RVs to 45 ft; $32 single/$50 double + $6 vehicle; rec.gov reservable 05-14..09-07, FCFS after; season 05-15..09-20; phone and FS page added.
flags: WATERFRONT KEEP creekside: Robinson Creek is hidden under a continuous riparian canopy on imagery, but 3DEP lidar shows its channel 5-15 m from site 018 (38.17991,-119.32233; RV 40 ft), 5-25 m from 013 (38.17856,-119.32130; 45 ft), 15-20 m from 009 (38.17923,-119.32175; 25 ft) and 25-30 m from 012 (38.17868,-119.32153; 35 ft), 1.4-2 m below the pads over gentle ground - an easy walk down; rec.gov: 'can be easily accessed from within the campground'.
